run_poststratify_single_variable: run poststratify on a single categorical variable to adjust sample weights to match target population distribution
run_poststratify_joint_distribution: run poststratify on the joint distribution of multiple variables to compute cell-based adjusted weights
run_poststratify_with_formula: run poststratify using a formula string like 'a:b:c' to select post-stratification variables instead of a list
run_poststratify_with_weight_trimming: run poststratify with weight trimming via mean ratio or percentile to clip extreme weight values
run_poststratify_store_metadata: run poststratify with store_fit_metadata enabled to persist fit artifacts for later weight reconstruction
